definition.stack: A+M_rp+ORG3(C19 N0; etgr object_poly tau=0 only), split_arch, honest-10 per-group thresholds, global greedy match (official rule: cov=inter/min area>=0.5 & pred representative point in GT)
definition.oracle_hit: keep exactly the candidates that the official greedy (full pool, conf order) matches, FP=0
definition.oracle_bip: max bipartite matching over ok pairs of all own candidates, FP=0
definition.fp_dup: kept non-hit candidate with ok pair to a GT already matched; _x = matched by other threshold group (modality)
definition.fp_geom: kept non-hit, no ok pair, overlaps a GT (cov>0 / point within R) but fails cov>=0.5 or interior point
definition.fn_thr: GT matchable by a candidate below honest threshold
definition.fn_assign: GT with ok candidate kept but greedy one-to-one gave it to another GT (no pipeline-dedup info in stack)
definition.fn_geom: GT with only near candidates (fails rule)
definition.fn_wrong: no own-class ok candidate; another class has an ok-pair candidate (_kept: that candidate passes its honest threshold). Precedence: thr > assign > wrong > geom > nocand. Lever adds TP only (FP of the wrong copy not removed)
definition.dedup: pipeline dedup happens before the stack, not visible; fn_assign = one-to-one greedy conflict
